description: Use this when an address should receive mail again after it was suppressed for a bounce, a complaint, or a manual add. Requires auth. Deletes that one account-wide row. Inputs: address (required; email). Returns the suppression with deleted true. Fails with 400 invalid_address, 404 suppression_not_found, or 403 permission_denied for an inbox-scoped key. Sending to a still-suppressed address returns 403 recipient_suppressed and nothing is sent.

address.description: Email address to remove from the account suppression list.

name: cooper_delete_suppression

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

deleted.description: True when the object was deleted.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

source_message_id.description: Message that caused the suppression, or null.

title: Remove a suppressed address
